sentences: A threshold-of-threshold circuit applies threshold gates in two successive layers.
The saved question seeks exponential lower bounds without imposing additional restrictions on those gates.
Arbitrary weights and hidden-layer combinations can encode substantially more than a single threshold, making simple geometric arguments insufficient.
A lower bound would expose a strong limitation of a shallow model related to weighted voting and classification.
